title: eludite.resx.access_modifier input
description: Set a resource set's Access Modifier, the list at the top of the `.resx` editor as in Visual Studio's (proposal 0005): `internal` or `public` sets the neutral file's `Generator` item metadata (`ResXFileCodeGenerator`, `PublicResXFileCodeGenerator`) through the host and regenerates `Name.Designer.cs` (or `.vb`); `none` removes the metadata and deletes the designer file. Needs a host and a project that lists the file. Class edit_buffer.

set.description: The resource set: the path of its neutral `.resx` file (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder), or of any of its culture files, which names the same set.

modifier.description: The Access Modifier of the generated designer class: `internal` (ResXFileCodeGenerator), `public` (PublicResXFileCodeGenerator) or `none` (no code generation, no designer file).
